notes.title: Demo Update 250816 is now live! - Skirmish MOde
notes.content: [p]Commanders, trial version update 2508016 is now live![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Added Skirmish Mode[/b][/h3][p]Set Opponents and combat rules to customize battle experiences.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453228/636836cfc27537297c3fedc82dc3a31deca7ff31.png"][/img][/p][p]Commanders can be selected, with two currently unlocked.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453228/85b1c13a92c3e8b08ccd0ab08bb35caa61cd4d3a.png"][/img][/p][p]Currently includes 5 maps, 23 units and structures.[/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453228/fc57517c3ca309c0b6a87d4f0a53d322d2e8909c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Other Improvements[/b][/h3][p]Improved UI interface style. [/p][p]Adjusted color scheme for battlefield environments. [/p][p]Replaced new unit equipment icons with abstract pattern style. [/p][p]Extractor income increased from 100 to 200, and removed the extra income bonus mechanism based on crystal quantity (crystal quantities in all campaign missions adjusted accordingly). [/p][p]Added basic operation and hotkey prompts at the bottom of the screen. [/p][p]When producing units, right-clicking blueprints selects them, allowing detailed information viewing in the left unit info panel. [/p][p]When placing building blueprints, clicking empty ground directly cancels selection.[/p][p]When selecting engineering units, displays wreckage quantities within their movement range. [/p][p]Mega units can overlap with positions of allied small units. [/p][p]Mega units do not benefit from terrain defense effects. [/p][p]Adjusted visual design of Raider Spiders.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][p]Fixed movement sounds not obeying audio volume settings. [/p][p]Reduced stuttering caused by unit deaths.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Note[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Due to significant changes in Extractor income values, loading previous combat saves will result in higher income—restarting missions is strongly recommended.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 250704 is now live! - Three New Levels
notes.content: [p]Commanders, demo update 250704 is now live![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Challenge three new missions now![/b][/h3][p]1-2 Ranged Strike[/p][p]1-3 Spider Attack[/p][p]1-4 Awakening Protocol[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453228/feafeb64ea3ad75225ff7c277a9cc6d0dcb7e567.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][p]New option that allows setting player's team color to blue, enemy's to red.[/p][p]New items added to Database, some images improved .[/p][p]New option that allows edge scrolling.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][p]Unit that can only target enemy in FOW, won't be added to idle unit list now.[/p][p]Fixed a bug that cause Commander equipment icon appears in wrong color.[/p][p]Fixed a localization problem in level 1-1.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 250629 is now live! - Level Redesign and Story Revision
notes.content: [p][b]Commanders,[/b][/p][p]Based on your previous feedback, we've implemented a [b]major overhaul[/b] of the game—including [b]level redesigns[/b], [b]difficulty tuning[/b], and [b]story revisions[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Redesigned Levels[/b][/h3][p]We've introduced a brand-new introductory mission that showcases more gameplay content, allowing players to experience late-game units early.[/p][p]Additionally, we've slowed the pace of the tutorial levels, creating a stress-free environment for players to learn the game while demonstrating more specific tactical approaches.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453228/ea5d0356f2ab7f4f5e98b68342cb5eef0eb8b2a9.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Story Revamp[/b][/h3][p]The narrative now adopts a more accessible style. You play as a newly appointed Commander, leading humanity's resistance against the threat of AI Chaos Entity.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453228/422b99b02d030b38b0c413cf03b979037778dd13.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Unit Distinguishability Improvements[/b][/h3][p]The Engineering Vehicle's model has been redesigned to enhance visual distinction from Recon. Vehicles.  All units now feature unit icons displaying Unit Class and Armor Type (Shield-shaped outlines denoting armored units).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453228/62dad05042d6623e1a918eb5bbb4c1016651bb3c.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h3][p]All tutorial content link into Database where you can read any time.[/p][p]Attackable targets now display counter indicators.[/p][p]Damage popups include counter relationship markers.[/p][p]Engineering Vehicles preview build outcomes and resource warnings.[/p][p]Factory blueprints highlight missing resources/slot shortages seperately.[/p][p]Added Quick Save (F5) with dedicated folder storage.[/p][p]Enhanced save operation notifications.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Environment Art Updates[/b][/h3][p][b]Halark Planet [/b]Cover objects replaced stone pillars with alien cactus.[/p][p]Unit always appear before cover objects.[/p][p]Added [b]Hyperion Prime[/b] human headquarters theme[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][p]Fixed bug that cause unit not able to recover to unmoved state when staying at orginal place then selecting other units.[/p][p]Resolved tooltip display issues on 16:10 aspect ratios.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Future Content[/b][/h3][p]New demo missions incoming (including some levels from old version).[/p][p][/p][h3][b]About Old Version[/b][/h3][p]To continue missions in old version, you can switch game versions mannaully.[/p][p]Due to level restructuring, saves ARE NOT compatible between versions, but updated game now stores save files at a different location. Switching between versions will not cause save file conflicts..[/p][p][/p][h3][b]How to Switch Versions[/b][/h3][p]Right-click game in Steam Library → Properties → Betas → Select version 250609.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 250609 is now live! - Death fragment and visual upgrades
notes.content: [p]Commanders,  content update 250609 for Tactical Annihilation Demo is now live！[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Death Fragments[/b][/h3][p]Units now produce physically simulated death fragments upon destruction.[/p][p]This effect differs during the Prologue missions.[/p][p]Note: This is a visual system only, distinct from wrecks (which provides metal resources).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453228/e29ac8278c0acc53f0bee6347b1a71a1760004f9.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Environment Art Upgrade[/b][/h3][p]Improved lighting design; resource crystals now have enhanced visibility.[/p][p]Added new ground texture types and transition effects across all environment themes.[/p][p]New mechanical walls that block direct attacks and ground unit movement (air units unaffected).[/p][quote][p]Note: Level terrain changes require restarting the mission to take effect.[/p][/quote][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453228/a31dc0900cba646b842ed6fa62957094b02299b9.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Divi is Watching[/b][/h3][p]Divi now guides players via light indicators during Prologue missions.[/p][p]Divi actively observes the battlefield during combat.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453228/47f45c91266017d5d88c8272005e6de8f519ff4c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]General Improvements:[/b][/h3][p]Mission selection and loading screens now display stage background art.[/p][p]Equipment and chassis stats now appear as icons in unit panels, reducing UI obstruction.[/p][p]Redesigned danger zone and move/attack range visuals for clearer overlapping display.[/p][p]End-of-turn prompts now show unit action status and valid tagets for idle units.[/p][p]Units retain their facing direction after moving/attacking until turn end.[/p][p]New campaigns unlock all Prologue missions and start from mission selection after the intro.[/p][p]Multi-unit "Undo Move" icons now only shows one, with quantity indicators.[/p][p]Enhanced model textures (emissive/normal maps) for multiple units.[/p][p]Added impact area VFX for the Mega Assault Tank.[/p][p]Kill markers ("X") are now smaller and less obstructive.[/p][p]Replaced one player-phase background music.[/p][p]New campaigns now generate an initial autosave immediately.[/p][p]Reduced difficulty of Hard Mode in Mission 1-4.[/p][p]Radar Stations now only show detection range when selected (not on hover).[/p][p]Action-completed units no longer display attack ranges when selected to avoid confusion.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]General Fixes:[/b][/h3][p]Fixed AI Engineers attempting self-repair causing errors.[/p][p]Fixed uncloseable "Overwrite Save?" confirmation popup.[/p][p]Fixed Mission 1-4 tutorial stuck when Commander was (accidentally) selected during intro cutscene.[/p]

notes.title: Update 250603R2 is now live! - Hotfix for decimal-comma cultured users
notes.content:
Commanders,  update 250603R2 for Tactical Annihilation Demo is now live！

[b]Major fixes：[/b]
Fixed a serious problem that caused decimal-comma cultured users unable to play the game.
Before the fix, if decimal seperator is comma (instead of dot) in your languge, then the game would load its data in a wrong way, causing all kinds of problems and making the game unplayable.

After the fix, in the first cut-scene, you should see a red robot lying among the ruins, then a drone comes to find him.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453228/a90fff20d03e19a9dddc48ff03e1e5a04062ca60.png[/img]

notes.title: DEMO Update 250603 Now Live - Hotfix and improvements to prologue levels
notes.content:
Commanders，the first update 250603 for Tactical Annihilation Demo is now live！

[b]Major fixes：[/b]
Fix problems in level 0-1 that may cause player stuck during tutorial steps.
Fix bug that keyboard shortcut still being effective when save file or other popup shows.
Fix problem that cause autosave happened at improper time at level 1-4 start.

[b]Minor fixes：[/b]
Fix bug that volume settings are not effective after relaunching game.
Fix bug that level 0-3 that shows no difference under difficulty settings.

[b]Improvements：[/b]
Improve the tutorial scripting in prologue levels.
Slightly increase overall difficulty for level 0-2, 0-3.
Allow cut-scene level to be skipped by pressing ESC.
Rise auto-saving max file number to 50.
Change the game app icon.
